Questions 11–16

Complete the notes below.

Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

SPORTS WORLD

  • SPORTS WORLD
  • a new of an international sports goods company
  • located in the shopping center to the of Bradcaster
  • had sports and equipment on floors 1-3
  • can get you any item within days
  • shop specialises in equipment for
  • has a special section which just sells

Questions 17 and 18

Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

17 A champion athlete will be in the shop

18 The first person to answer 20 quiz questions correctly will win

Questions 19 and 20

Choose TWO letters, A—E.

Which TWO pieces of information does the speaker give about the fitness test?

transcript.en: Now we go to Jane who is going to tell us about what's happening in town this weekend.
transcript.zh: 现在我们交给简，她会告诉我们这个周末城镇上将会发生什么。

transcript.en: Right, thanks, Andrew, and now on to what's new, and do we really need yet another sports shop in Bradcaster?
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢安德鲁，现在有什么新鲜事，我们在Bradcaster真的需要另一家体育用品商店吗？

transcript.en: Well, most of you probably know Sports World - the branch of a Danish sports goods company that opened a few years ago - it's attracted a lot of custom, and so the company has now decided to open another branch in the area.
transcript.zh: 你们中的多数人可能知道丹麦体育用品公司的分店“体育天地”在几年前开业，并吸引了大量的客人，所以这个公司现在决定在该地区开另一家分店。

transcript.en: It's going to be in the shopping center to the west of Bradcaster, so that will be good news for all of you who found the original shop in the North of the town hard to get to.
transcript.zh: 它将在Bradcaster西边的购物中心开业，对于那些觉得原先在城镇北面的商店太远的人来说是一个好消息。

transcript.en: I was invited to a special preview and I can promise you, this is the ultimate in sports retailing.
transcript.zh: 我应邀预先参观，我向你们保证这将是体育零售业的旗舰店。

transcript.en: The whole place has been given a new minimalist look with the company's signature colors of black and red.
transcript.zh: 公司标志性的颜色黑色和红色带给整个地方一种全新的极简主义外观

transcript.en: The first three floors have a huge range of sports clothing as well as the equipment.
transcript.zh: 下面三层有大量的体育服装和器材

transcript.en: And on the top floor, there is a cafe and a book & DVD section.
transcript.zh: 顶层有咖啡，书店和光盘区域

transcript.en: You'll find all the well-known names as well as some less well-known ones.
transcript.zh: 你会找到所有知名和一些鲜为人知的东西。

transcript.en: If they haven't got exactly what you want in the stock, they promised to get it for you in 10 days, unlike the other store, where it can take up to 14 days.
transcript.zh: 如果他们没有你要找的东西，他们保证会在10天内为你找到。不像另一家商店要等上14天。

transcript.en: They cover all the major sports, including football, tennis, and swimming, but they particularly focus on running and they claim to have the widest range of equipment in the country.
transcript.zh: 他们覆盖所有主要的运动，包括足球、网球、游泳，但是他们特别关注于跑步，他们声称是全国拥有器材最为广泛的一家公司。

transcript.en: As well as that, a whole section of the third floor is devoted to sports bags, including the latest designs from the States - If you can't find what you want here, it doesn't exist.
transcript.zh: 除此之外，整个三层致力于运动包的销售，包括来自美国的最新设计。如果你不能在这里找到想要的，那么它就不存在！

transcript.en: The shop will be open from 9 am this Saturday and if you go along to the opening then you'll have the chance to meet the national 400 meters running champion Paul King, who's coming along to open the shop, and he will be staying around until about midday to chat to any fans who want to meet him and sign autographs.
transcript.zh: 商店将于这周六早上9点开业，如果你去开幕式，你将会遇到国家400米跑步冠军保罗·金。他也将一起为商店开张，他将待到中午左右与粉丝聊天、签名。

transcript.en: Then there will be a whole range of special attractions all weekend.
transcript.zh: 然后在所有周末将会有大量吸引人的特殊项目

transcript.en: There will be free tickets for local sporting events for the first 50 customers, and also a special competition open to all, just answer 15 out of 20 sports questions correctly to win a signed copy of Paul King's DVD 'Spring Tips', while the first person to get all the questions correct gets a year's free membership of the Bradcaster Gym.
transcript.zh: 对于前50名的客人将会免费赠予当地体育赛事的门票，另外还有一个特殊的竞赛向公众开放。只要从20道体育问题中回答正确15题，就能赢取保罗·金的签名光盘《Spring Tips》，第一位将所有问题回答正确的人将免费得到Bradcaster体育馆的全年会员资格。

transcript.en: All entrants will receive a special Sports calendar with details of all Bradcaster fixtures in the coming year.
transcript.zh: 所有参赛者都将获得一份特殊的体育日历，上面标有明年所有Bradcaster体育活动的详细信息。

transcript.en: One of the special opening offers is a fitness test - a complete review of your cardiac fitness and muscle tone, actually done in the shop by qualified staff.
transcript.zh: 其中一个特殊的开业特价是健康测试，由商店合格的工作人员全方面检查你的心脏健康和肌肉紧张度。

transcript.en: This would normally cost 30 pounds but is available at half price for this month only.
transcript.zh: 这通常要花费30英镑，但是只在这个月半价。

transcript.en: There are only a limited number of places available for this, so to make a booking phone 560341.
transcript.zh: 这项活动的地方有限，所以要拨打560341进行电话预约。

transcript.en: In addition, if you open an account you get lots more special offers including the chance to try out the equipment at the special opening evenings...
transcript.zh: 另外，如果你开一个账户，你会得到更多的特殊优惠，包括在特殊的开放日夜晚体验器材的机会。
